title: Learning to Select Features with Manifold Deep Unfolding PCA
abstract: arXiv:2610.19436v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Unsupervised feature selection (UFS) is of great significance in image processing and pattern recognition. Nevertheless, existing model-based methods often rely on manually tuned hyperparameters, while deep learning-based methods generally require massive training data. To address these issues, this paper proposes an efficient manifold deep unfolding feature selection network (MDUFS-Net). Technically, we first incorporate the $\ell_{2,0}$-norm into the classic principal component analysis (PCA) framework, then unfold the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM)-based iterative algorithm into an end-to-end trainable network, thereby enabling automatic parameter learning. Moreover, a manifold optimization strategy is developed to improve the numerical robustness. On this basis, we further extend MDUFS-Net into an enhanced variant called MDUFS-Net+ by introducing the $\ell_{0}$-norm for more discriminative feature representation

translated_title: 基于流形深度展开PCA的特征选择学习方法
translated_abstract: 无监督特征选择（UFS）在图像处理和模式识别中具有重要意义。然而，现有的基于模型的方法通常依赖手动调节的超参数，而基于深度学习的方法一般需要大量训练数据。为解决这些问题，本文提出了一种高效的流形深度展开特征选择网络（MDUFS-Net）。在技术上，我们首先将ℓ_{2,0}范数引入经典的主成分分析（PCA）框架，然后将基于交替方向乘子法（ADMM）的迭代算法展开为端到端可训练的网络，从而实现参数的自动学习。此外，我们还开发了一种流形优化策略以提高数值鲁棒性。在此基础上，我们进一步通过引入ℓ_0范数以获得更具判别性的特征表示，将MDUFS-Net扩展为增强变体MDUFS-Net+。
tldr: 本文提出MDUFS-Net，通过将ℓ_{2,0}范数融入PCA框架并将ADMM迭代算法深度展开为端到端可训练网络，结合流形优化策略实现参数自动学习和数值鲁棒性提升，兼顾了模型方法的轻量性与深度方法的自动化优势。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MDUFS-Net, which incorporates the ℓ_{2,0}-norm into the PCA framework and unfolds the ADMM-based iterative algorithm into an end-to-end trainable network with manifold optimization, enabling automatic parameter learning for unsupervised feature selection without requiring massive training data.
